title: DVNA
description: Damn Vulnerable NodeJS Application by Appsecco: an Express and MySQL application that demonstrates the OWASP Top 10 (2017) in Node.js, from command and SQL injection to XXE, insecure deserialization and broken access control, with a guide for exploiting and fixing each flaw.
question: Use the ping page's command injection to run a command on the server and read /ctf/flag.
